wars.name: Slavic sieges of Thessalonica
wars.outcome: The Drougoubitai, Sagoudatai, Belegezitai, Baiounetai and Berzetai besieged Thessalonica in 614-616; a combined Avar and Slav siege failed in 617; the Rhynchinoi, Sagoudatai, Drougoubitai and Strymonitai besieged it for two years in 676-678 while the…

wars.name: Constans II's campaign against the Sclaviniae
wars.outcome: Constans II 'conquered Sklavinia' in 657-658, 'capturing many and subduing', and settled captured Slavs in Asia Minor.

wars.name: Staurakios's campaign and the Slavic uprising of 783
wars.outcome: Staurakios campaigned from Thessalonica into Thessaly and the Peloponnese in 782-784, quelled a large Slavic uprising 'from Macedonia to the Peloponnese' in 783 and transferred many Slavs to Anatolia.

wars.name: Slavic siege of Patras
wars.outcome: A Slavic siege of Patras failed in 805 (or 807); Patras was recovered and resettled with Greeks and the Theme of the Peloponnese was created.

certainty.note: Tribal territories with no recorded boundaries; the Macedonian and Peloponnesian extents are the researcher's reading of sieges and settlement patterns.
